entries.09ea8ccca2aa5a77: MRT Inc. is headquartered in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo, and forms a group with 13 consolidated subsidiaries and 1 equity-method affiliate. As of December 31, 2025, the number of employees was 307, and it is listed on the Growth Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.0b02f4424523b483: This service centers on 'Gaikin', part-time physician placement using a physician placement website, and 'career', full-time physician placement. It also provides part-time job placement, career change placement and introductory temporary staffing for paramedics such as nurses, pharmacists and clinical laboratory technologists. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥3,061 million.
entries.1695053d44a312d5: This service centers on 'Gaikin', part-time physician placement using a physician placement website, and 'career', full-time physician placement.
entries.1769219efda43521: Mainly placement fees from medical institutions
entries.222c02af20e2fc3c: It is a business model that connects physician members and medical institutions via the internet, and when a physician placement is concluded, it receives placement fees from the recruiting medical institution.
entries.251615c78d770e23: This single-segment business, launched on the basis of a mutual aid organization for physicians, is built on a human resources network in the medical field. It consists of medical staffing services centered on physician placement and other services, and revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥4,191 million.
entries.29e5e7a234ff94f4: Physicians register as members after their licenses and other official documents are verified, and medical institutions post job requirements on the site and receive applications. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, no single counterparty accounted for 10% or more of total revenue.
entries.3ba89571c1c29f0b: This is because the Business Description section states that, according to a Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare survey, part-time physicians accounted for 18.3% of physicians working at medical institutions (as of June 1, 2010), and that support from part-time physicians is considered indispensable due to the uneven regional distribution of doctors and the skew in medical specialties.
entries.3e5aada145369987: It provides, among others, the groupware 'Net Ikyoku®' supporting medical office work, the online medical consultation and health counseling services 'Door.into Kenko Iryo Sodan' and 'Pocket Doctor', marketing and product development support by physicians, publishing, support for medical institution operations, registration and reception center operations (BPO) for local governments and companies, and a medical device platform.
entries.4205180d6af22172: It provides, among others, the groupware 'Net Ikyoku®' supporting medical office work, the online medical consultation and health counseling services 'Door.into Kenko Iryo Sodan' and 'Pocket Doctor', marketing and product development support by physicians, publishing, support for medical institution operations, registration and reception center operations (BPO) for local governments and companies, and a medical device platform. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,130 million.
entries.54ad7d9ddf02f2e1: Physician placement fees received from medical institutions
entries.78f8c4eff495b8a5: Fees for paramedical staff placement and temp-to-hire dispatch
entries.804209ee074220dc: Through its physician placement sites and app, it provides part-time and full-time physician placement and paramedical staffing, and also offers peripheral services such as Net Ikyoku® and online medical care.
entries.86c619c79d33466a: Online medical care and health consultation services 'Door.into Health & Medical Consultation' and 'Pocket Doctor'
entries.8802b1ca9b522bfe: Medical staffing platform company originating from a physicians' mutual aid organization
entries.8dc35b9dac8fc5be: This is because the Business Description states that the company has established its business foundation with a medical-field talent network built up through its founding background and accumulated operating experience and know-how as a strength, and that submission of official documents certifying a physician's license and a résumé is required when physicians register as members.
entries.9271364efa273348: This single-segment business, launched on the basis of a mutual aid organization for physicians, is built on a human resources network in the medical field.
entries.b63c5d631336123f: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥4,191 million, of which medical staffing services accounted for ¥3,061 million and other businesses for ¥1,130 million. Full-time physician placement grew, and revenue increased 0.6% from the previous year.
entries.c251ad726e84aaf9: Profit attributable to owners of parent for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥55 million, turning to profit from a net loss in the previous year.
entries.c31b56e71ebc893f: Medical information platform centered on physician placement
entries.c63e07ce24723f8c: Its strengths are a medical-field talent network built on the physicians' mutual aid organization as its base, and strict management of physician members, including license verification.
entries.cb53783f5f344e3e: Efforts in regional healthcare in cooperation with local governments and the launch of a medical staffing platform in Vietnam indicate that expansion beyond domestic physician placement is progressing, as can be read from the filing.
entries.ce6e35ca34b20c22: This is based on the management's analysis, which describes continued cooperation with Fukuyama City, Hiroshima Prefecture and Wakayama Prefecture, the rollout in Tokushima Prefecture of 'medical workation' that also targets paramedical staff, and the conclusion of a capital and business alliance in Vietnam together with the full-scale launch of the local medical staffing platform 'MRT HUB'.
entries.d20f446879270079: Medical institutions such as hospitals and clinics
entries.d52fed5798c10e13: Fees for other services such as online medical care and health consultations
entries.df74086c5d872155: It is positioned in a market with strong demand for part-time physicians, amid a continuing shortage of doctors and their uneven distribution across regions.
entries.e868b5e72f965107: Its policies are to expand services for medical departments, expand business into regional areas and leverage the group-wide shared platform, and it states that it is working to increase the number of registered physician members and registered medical institutions and to improve name recognition and awareness.
entries.eb9ccca1a8badad9: Physician members and recruiting medical institutions
entries.ef5621a4708afeac: A company that grew out of a mutual aid organization of physicians and operates a medical information platform centered on part-time and full-time physician placement through a physician referral site.
